The Odisha Sub-Staff Selection Commission (OUSSSC) has released the notification for the Combined Uniformed Services Examination 2026, aiming to fill over 7,000 vacancies for constables and firefighters. Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the official website at osssc.odisha.gov.in.

Vacancy and Post Overview

  • Issuing Authority: Odisha Sub-Staff Selection Commission (OUSSSC)
  • Notification ID/Name: Combined Uniformed Services Examination 2026
  • Total Vacancies: Over 7,000 posts
  • Posts Included: Constable Civil, Constable Communication, Firefighter, Firefighter Driver, Traffic Constable, Constable OISF, and Driver PMT

Eligibility and Age Criteria

  • Educational Qualifications:
  • For Constable Civil, Communication, Firefighter, Firefighter Driver, and Traffic Constable: At least 12th pass or equivalent from a recognized board.
  • For Constable OISF and Driver PMT: 10th pass.
  • Age Limit (as of January 1, 2026):
  • Minimum Age: 18 years for all posts.
  • Maximum Age: Varies by post (26 years for Constable Civil; 23 years for Constable Communication and OISF; up to 25 years for other specified roles).
  • Age Relaxation: Reserved category candidates are eligible for upper age relaxation as per government rules.

Application Fees, Dates, and Selection Stages

  • Application Dates: Not specified in the primary notification details.
  • Application Fees: Not specified.
  • Selection Stages: Single examination format (Combined Uniformed Services Examination).
  • Result, Admit Card, and Answer Key Status: Not specified.

Practical Implications and How to Verify

Candidates meeting the criteria should review the official notification thoroughly regarding category-wise breakdowns, physical standards, and exact submission timelines. To verify the announcement and apply, visit the official OUSSSC portal at osssc.odisha.gov.in. Avoid relying on unverified third-party links.
